h2: External pressure tests, multi-party witnessing and NDE review in Houston fabrication shops
html:
External pressure tests, multi-party witnessing and NDE review in Houston fabrication shops

"External pressure testing Houston TX" is the most frequent search behind this page, and it usually means one of two things. Either a part must be shown to resist collapse, which is a laboratory test, or a vessel designed for vacuum or external pressure is being built and the buyer wants its fabrication checked. Atlantis does not run test chambers. It supplies independent conventional NDT in the shop, UT, MT, PT and VT, and reviews the fabricator's NDE records as part of vendor inspection.

What is external pressure testing, and who does it?

External pressure is a design case, not just a test. ASME Section VIII Division 1 sets shell and head thickness for external pressure through rules that start at UG-28, and vacuum columns, jacketed vessels and subsea housings are designed to them. A physical external pressure test loads the part from outside in a pressure chamber. Laboratories publish chamber limits; Stress Engineering Services' testing brochure, for example, lists external pressurization to 30,000 psi alongside full-scale collapse tests. If the purchase order calls for such a test, the vendor inspector's job is to confirm the right part, pressure, hold time and gauge calibration, and to sign the record at a hold point.

How NDE is witnessed during vendor inspection

Most Houston shop orders put NDE on the inspection and test plan as a hold or witness point. An inspector who understands the method checks more than the result:

  • Ultrasonic testing: the procedure revision, beam angles, reference block and sensitivity record, and whether scanning covered the full weld volume. Where Section VIII allows ultrasonic examination in place of radiography and the purchaser agrees, UT becomes the volumetric method of record. See ultrasonic weld inspection.
  • Magnetic particle testing: field direction, field strength checks and coverage after post-weld heat treatment: magnetic particle weld inspection.
  • Liquid penetrant testing: surface preparation, dwell and developing times, and the temperature of the part: dye penetrant weld inspection.
  • Visual testing: weld profile, undercut and arc strikes before coating hides them.

Radiographs in Houston shops are taken by the fabricator's licensed radiography contractor, not by Atlantis, which does not perform radiography in the United States. Our Level III can review the films or digital images and the technique sheets as an independent check: radiographic film and digital interpretation review.

Multi-party witness inspection

On a code-stamped vessel, the fabricator's Authorized Inspector, the buyer's vendor inspector and sometimes the end user's inspector all want to attend the hydrostatic test and final NDE. Each has a different job: the Authorized Inspector for the code stamp, the vendor inspector for the purchase order, the end user for its own specification. Put all three on one notification list with the same notice period, agree in advance who signs which line of the test record, and settle any disagreement about acceptance criteria before the vessel is under pressure.

How Houston vendor inspection providers compare

Independence on a vendor order means the inspector reports to the buyer and is paid by the buyer, never by the fabricator; a "quality liaison" or buyer's representative at the supplier plays the same role with a lighter document scope. Mistras's Houston in-lab branch lists third-party inspection and vendor surveillance next to its laboratory NDT. Large testing, inspection and certification firms place resident inspectors at supplier works, and independent source inspectors work on individual purchase orders. When hold points sit on NDE, ask whether the inspector holds NDT certification in the methods being witnessed, which Level III stands behind the review, and when the release note and NDE review will be issued. Agree those dates in writing.

How Atlantis fits a Houston order

Atlantis is based in Houston. It can perform independent UT, MT, PT or VT on a vessel, spool or valve at the supplier's works, and Anoop Rayavarapu, our ASNT NDT Level III in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, reviews the fabricator's NDE procedures and reports against the purchase order. For equipment once installed, see pressure vessel inspection in Houston; for methods, ultrasonic testing in Houston; for procedure writing, ASNT Level III consulting. To place an order, send the purchase order and ITP through the Houston shop NDE enquiry; we reply within one business day.
